answer: Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through a zenith debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the vault totals, and the reef anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 30 units per epoch, sustaining 302 aliases for 53 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the copycat. The fee repeats 25 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
